title: Wire UI Builder engineering sphere continuity records

records.rule: Development evidence only until separately promoted.
Builder Studio is platform authoring infrastructure; consumer applications are separate target projects.
Resource objects may feed Wire; preserve resource id, occurrence uid and trigger provenance without making native identity authoritative.
Imported bound triggers map to semantic Wire actions; handler names remain provenance, not renderer-executable source.
Web, Windows, Swing, GTK, Android and direct Linux preserve the same semantic Wire contract even when presentation differs.
notNotes is a reference consumer/compatibility fixture, not Builder vocabulary or business authority.
Intention discovery/readiness is dynamic and refreshed; READY is required before effectful dispatch.
Browser presentation does not guess ambiguous time offsets; authoritative temporal semantics are external/application-owned.
Operational observation evidence must not become business authority.
Live topology crosses Queue Fabric Web Gateway and the same authoritative ObjectQueueManager into Wire UI Server.
HTTP/HTTPS front serves assets/bootstrap only; Node or ooRexx implementations are interchangeable only when the browser contract is byte/semantically equivalent.
Substitute only the HTTP front; keep JS, gateway, definitions and application state fixed.
Transport connected is not View ready and must not be labelled Live.
Working SOURCE proves semantic transport/rendering can work while DESIGN remains independently empty; diagnose DESIGN state/definition/composition rather than blaming HTTP generically.

provenance.claim: Accepted executable baseline and consumer-neutral Builder authority.
